findings.title: Selection at deepest level not rendered
findings.message: Depth check allows up to 4 levels of items, but a path of length 4 selects a level-4 item whose children (level 5) are rejected; path length 4 also means browserChildren yields level-5 column, which must be empty. A level-4 folder with children is therefore rejected, yet the docs say four levels; it is consistent, but Path len check allows 4 which opens a 5th (empty) column, so no column is rendered and the selected leaf is not visible as selected in any column.
findings.suggestion: Render the last column's selection even when the next level has no items, e.g. stop the loop after appending the final column using depth bounds rather than len(items)>0.

findings.title: Fraction cap may reject legitimate state
findings.message: The column loop walks the path while the ColumnBrowser validate allows depth up to 4 levels, but the preview split MinWidth and fraction map bound is MaxColumnBrowserDepth+1. When four path elements exist, columns can be 5 plus a preview (6), so valid Fractions entries for 5 dividers exceed the validate cap of 5 only barely, but with a Preview column the divider count can be 5 while the cap is 5; however the cap counts map entries from stale paths too. The gallery resets Fractions but a long path with preview can legitimately need more entries than allowed.
findings.suggestion: Bound Fractions by the actual divider count (columns including preview minus one) or MaxColumnBrowserDepth+2.
